invariants: Only .eos/state/canonical.json defines current EOS operational state.
Every operational mutation must first produce or update canonical machine-readable state and append a corresponding event.
TSV registries are rebuildable compatibility projections and must never be treated as an authority source.
Markdown remains governed human-readable content; lifecycle/status/relationship metadata embedded in Markdown is a projection of canonical state.
Git records history but does not resolve semantic disagreement by itself.
GitHub Issues, Projects, milestones, labels, and status fields are synchronized collaboration projections and cannot silently override canonical EOS state.
Every projection must be verifiably attributable to a canonical state revision or entity fingerprint.
Any disagreement is drift and must fail EOS state verification and CI.
